summary: Tested Cebraspe header/footer rollout + SEFAZ/AL 2026 concurso info on termos, inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao, inscricao-realizada, pagamento-pix, minhas-inscricoes. Static content pytest (19/19 incl. home regression). Desktop 1920: all 6 form pages render the shadow-DOM Cebraspe header (logo, Pagina de acompanhamento, 6 menu items) + dark-blue footer, header is first body child and footer last, no visible Vunesp/Unesp/Vestibular text or old logos, titles end with '| Cebraspe', no page errors. termos: Continuar disabled until checkbox -> /inscricao.html, Voltar -> /, acompanhamento -> /minhas-inscricoes.html. Full E2E from / -> termos -> inscricao (valid CPF + doc upload) -> dados-inscricao (option 'SEFAZ/AL 2026 - Edital nº 1') -> confirmacao -> inscricao-realizada (protocolo, R$ 225,00, PENDENTE) -> pagamento-pix worked; admin /api/admin/inscriptions shows concurso 'SEFAZ/AL 2026 - Cebraspe', edital 'SEFAZ_AL_26'. PIX showed 'Chave PIX nao configurada' with an empty key; after setting a temp key the QR + BR code generated correctly (settings restored afterwards). Header links only '/', '/termos.html', '/minhas-inscricoes.html'; footer links '#' and do nothing. Mobile 360 Android UA, 390 iPhone UA, 820 iPad UA: hamburger visible on all 7 pages, drawer opens and closes via X, backdrop and Escape, scrollWidth overflow 0, layout/footer readable.

minor.issue: Fallback PIX receiver name is still 'VESTIBULAR UNESP 2027' and the city is 'SAO PAULO' when pix_nome/pix_cidade are empty. The startup seed (admin_routes.py:172) also seeds pix_nome 'Vestibular Unesp 2027'. A candidate's bank app could show the old name.

Candidate confirmation e-mail still uses EMAIL_FROM_NAME 'Vestibular Unesp 2027', CONCURSO_NOME 'Vestibular Unesp 2027 - Fundação VUNESP', the VUNESP logo/alt text and the 'Vestibular:' row label. This is concurso info outside the HTML pages.
Telegram default title is 'NOVA INSCRIÇÃO - VESTIBULAR UNESP 2027' (admin-only).

issues: Copyright reads '© 2019, Cebraspe.' (copied from the home page). Consider 2026.

Course options are still UNESP courses (e.g. 'Medicina Veterinária - integral - FMVA/Araçatuba'). The requirement kept form fields unchanged, but the course appears as 'Curso Escolhido' on the summary/PIX pages, which conflicts with the SEFAZ/AL branding. Flag to the user.

action_items: Optional: replace the 'VESTIBULAR UNESP 2027'/'SAO PAULO' PIX name/city fallbacks and the seed with SEFAZ/AL-Cebraspe values
Optional: update email_service.py branding (from-name, CONCURSO_NOME, logo, 'Vestibular:' label) to SEFAZ/AL 2026 - Cebraspe
